title: Monotone Sobolev functions: approximation, critical points, and level sets
summary: We give an affirmative answer to the planar local smoothing problem in Question~1.7 of D.~Ntalampekos and positive and negative answers to the basic approximation and level-set parts of his higher-dimensional Question~1.8. In every dimension $n\ge2$, each continuous Lebesgue monotone function in $W^{1,p}$ on a bounded open set admits uniform and strong $W^{1,p}$ approximation by monotone $C^{1,α}_{\loc}$ functions, with unchanged Sobolev boundary values and no increase of the $p$-Dirichlet energy, for $1<p<\infty$.
